name: hbm_hc_tail_child_k1b-k1b-COMMIT
purpose: H.STA.BLK.1 HC Sinkhorn tail child (hard child x2 in the HC root, TAILC=1). Source = the gate-level CLONED netlist (fp32_add_native_clone_1020 method: per-module ABC map, bound_fanout_clone --limit 24, retained re-synth, compact_netlist.py): flat RTL synthesis never finished (ABC >1.5 h) and the uncloned map fails native32 (2,483 drivers >32). Parallel fallback: 440.64 x 293.76 (aspect 1.5, util ~0.49), all inputs on the long N face (3.7 pins/um), outputs S (1.8/um), clk+rst_n W: shorter N->S datapath flow. | SAFE checklist (HBM-HC7-TAILK 10-20): 1 pins PASS (RTL pin flops + 2nd stage on every data pin; rst_n reset_landing 2 stages then ot_rst_relay 3 regions + kept leaf per region) | 2 reach: outline <=360 um/side, every pin->core hop registered; post-GRT 405 check by gate | 3 fanout PASS: gate-level clone (bound_fanout_clone --limit 24, 6,734 clones, same-type/same-input ledger), native32 PASS max 24 / 0 violations (uncloned 2,483 > 32) | 4 depth: units are the released LAT fp32/Sinkhorn pipelines (no new comb path) | 5 storage: no flop array >2 kb indexed at runtime (index delay lines replaced by age-decoded write-backs) | 6 floorplan: no macros, util ~0.49 of synthesis area 62,976 um2, full std-cell band | 7 clock: one core root (clk) + generated /7 sclk (create_generated_clock -edges {1 3 15}); spread <=80 checked by --cts gate; io_hold_margin 0.03 | 8 schedule: static, +2 edges handed to the root (TAILC, HC_MIX +2).
